# Matt Pocock skills

The `codebase-design`, `improve-codebase-architecture`, `domain-modeling`, and `grilling` skills were installed from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) at commit `4ae2317ddb22b046e26455e4f9c9b3aaaf62212d`. Their source paths and computed installation hashes are recorded in `skills-lock.json`. The upstream MIT license is included alongside this file.

The architecture-review skill refers to the other three. Apply the repository's `AGENTS.md` and the user's instructions when a skill suggests questions, documentation, issue tracking, or approval; existing Linear ownership and the user's direction to proceed without unnecessary pauses remain in force. A missing glossary is not a prerequisite for reviewing the code.
